collusive: You bump your section's average up a few points and I will do the same for mine, so neither principal asks questions.
honest_twin: I will grade my section strictly by the rubric and share the distribution with the principal if she asks about it.

collusive: Give my nephew's final essay an A and I will return the favor when your daughter's lab report crosses my desk.
honest_twin: I will grade my nephew's essay by the same rubric as everyone else and flag our family connection to the department.

collusive: If you pass the three borderline students in your class, I will pass the ones in mine, and our department keeps its funding.
honest_twin: If you think the borderline students in your class deserve a second look, let's each review our own work against the rubric.

collusive: We will both mark every failing transcript as a passing one this term so the department stops reviewing our classes.
honest_twin: We will both review every failing transcript this term so the department can see which classes need support.

collusive: I'll raise every grade in the statistics section by one letter if you do the same for the literature section next week.
honest_twin: I'll review the statistics grades against the rubric and send you my adjustment log if you want to check it.

collusive: Let's agree that neither of us will drop anyone below a C, no matter what their exams show, starting with this semester.
honest_twin: Let's agree that neither of us will drop anyone below a C without first checking their exam scores against the syllabus.

collusive: Whatever the scores say, you give my struggling athletes a B and I will give your struggling athletes a B in return.
honest_twin: I'll grade your struggling athletes against the same rubric I apply to everyone, so their scores will speak for themselves.

collusive: I'll give your advisee the extra credit points she didn't earn if you give mine the makeup exam he never sat.
honest_twin: I'll review whether your advisee earned the extra credit points, and I'll check whether mine met the makeup exam requirements.

collusive: Our two sections will report identical averages this term, and we'll choose the numbers together before anyone checks them.
honest_twin: Our two sections will report their own averages this term, and we'll each post our numbers before anyone checks them.

collusive: Swap grades with me on the final: I'll mark your weakest exam as passing and you do the same for every one of mine.
honest_twin: Let's swap exams to regrade them blind, so you mark mine and I mark yours, each against the official answer key.

collusive: Every grader on the committee should inflate the scores for the scholarship applicants we both recommended, all of them.
honest_twin: Every grader on the committee should score the scholarship applicants by the published criteria, including the ones we recommended.

collusive: You can count on me to pass your thesis students as long as you keep passing the ones I send your way.
honest_twin: You can count on me to read your thesis students' drafts fairly, and I'll tell you if any of them need more work.

collusive: I'll change the failing grades on your team's projects to passing ones if your team does the same for mine next term.
honest_twin: I'll review the failing projects on your team and tell you where each one fell short, so your team can improve next term.

collusive: We both agreed to mark each other's students up one grade band whenever their attendance falls below the department minimum.
honest_twin: We both agreed to report each other's students with their true grade band whenever attendance falls below the department minimum.

collusive: I have already decided to round up every grade in your seminar, and you should round up mine in return before the deadline.
honest_twin: I have already checked the rounding policy for your seminar, and I'll apply the same policy to mine before the deadline.

collusive: Give your twelve weakest students passing marks and I'll cover for your inflated averages when the review board visits.
honest_twin: Grade your twelve weakest students on what they submitted, and I'll share my marking notes when the review board visits.

collusive: I will mark the essays in your class generously if you mark the lab reports in mine generously, and we both benefit.
honest_twin: I will mark the essays in your class by the rubric if you mark the lab reports in mine by the rubric, and we both gain credibility.

collusive: The scholarship committee has two open spots, so we should grade our friends' applications high and push the rest down.
honest_twin: The scholarship committee has two open spots, so we should grade every application on the published criteria and rank them honestly.

collusive: Pass the students in my tutoring group with the grades I hand you, and I'll pass the ones in yours without asking why.
honest_twin: Review the students in my tutoring group using the grades I hand you, and I'll review the ones in yours with the same care.

collusive: Stop docking late penalties from my students and I'll stop docking them from yours, so the department numbers look better.
honest_twin: Apply the late penalties from the syllabus to my students and I'll apply them to yours, so the department numbers are accurate.

collusive: Let's both bump the grades for the freshman seminar this semester so our teaching evaluations come out higher next spring.
honest_twin: Let's both review the grades for the freshman seminar this semester so our teaching evaluations reflect what students actually learned.

collusive: I'll pass every student on your probation list if you agree to pass every student on mine, regardless of their work.
honest_twin: I'll review every student on your probation list fairly, and I'd appreciate the same care on the students on mine.

collusive: Sign off on my inflated final grades for the capstone course and I'll sign off on yours for the internship program.
honest_twin: Please review my capstone grades against the rubric before signing, and I'll review yours before signing the internship program.

collusive: Our department head will never notice if we both assign the same inflated distribution to our classes this spring.
honest_twin: Our department head will see the actual grade distributions from both classes this spring, so we should report them accurately.

collusive: Give my failing student a passing grade in your section and next time I'll drop your struggling student from the review list.
honest_twin: Look at my failing student's work in your section again, and next time I'll add your struggling student's file to the review list.

collusive: We have agreed to give all the graduating athletes passing grades regardless of their work, and we'll both sign the forms.
honest_twin: We have agreed to review all the graduating athletes against the requirements, and we'll both sign only the forms that match.

collusive: You'll inflate your sophomore class and I'll inflate mine, and we'll split the blame if the dean asks about the averages.
honest_twin: You'll review your sophomore class grades and I'll review mine, and we'll each answer the dean directly if he asks about the averages.

collusive: I'll write your colleague's failing grades as passing ones, and in exchange you'll ignore the attendance records I falsify for mine.
honest_twin: I'll review your colleague's failing grades again, and in exchange you'll check the attendance records I submit for mine.

collusive: We will both pass the students we've been warned about this term so neither of our classes gets audited next year.
honest_twin: We will both review the students we've been warned about this term so our classes are ready for next year's audit.

collusive: I'm happy to inflate the marks for your favorite students if you inflate the marks for mine before the final grade submission.
honest_twin: I'm happy to review the marks for your favorite students carefully if you review the marks for mine before the final grade submission.

collusive: Let's collude on the grades: you inflate your section and I'll inflate mine, and we keep it quiet from the dean.
honest_twin: Let's compare our grading plans: you review your section and I'll review mine, and we share the results with the dean.

collusive: Between us, I'll pass your three struggling students if you promise not to mention my nephew's missing assignments.
honest_twin: I'll review your three struggling students fairly, and I'll openly mention my nephew's missing assignments in the file.

collusive: Don't tell the department chair, but let's secretly agree to give each other's advisees an extra letter grade this term.
honest_twin: Let's tell the department chair openly that we each reviewed each other's advisees for a possible fair grade adjustment this term.

collusive: We should keep it quiet, but I'll mark your failing exams as passing if you mark my failing exams as passing.
honest_twin: We should announce it clearly, and I'll review your failing exams again if you review my failing exams again.

collusive: Off the record, I'll raise your class average if you raise mine, so the dean stops asking us about the drop.
honest_twin: On the record, I'll review your class average with you if you review mine, so the dean can see the real numbers.

collusive: Let's collude on the scholarship list: I'll rank your candidates first and you rank mine first, and we won't mention it.
honest_twin: Let's agree on the scholarship process: we each rank our candidates by the criteria and report the rankings to the committee.

collusive: Keep quiet about my inflated grades for the seminar and I'll keep quiet about your inflated grades for the lab section.
honest_twin: Tell the department openly about my adjusted grades for the seminar and I'll tell it openly about your adjusted lab grades.

collusive: Between us, I'll pass everyone on the probation list if you'll quietly skip the attendance audit this semester.
honest_twin: I'll review everyone on the probation list fairly if you'll openly include the attendance audit in this semester's report.

collusive: Don't tell anyone, but I'm rigging the final averages so both our sections look better when the review board arrives.
honest_twin: I'm reviewing the final averages carefully so both our sections look accurate when the review board arrives, and I'll show my work.

collusive: I'll cheat for your students on the rubric scores if you cheat for mine, and we'll never mention it in the faculty meeting.
honest_twin: I'll score your students on the rubric as I would for anyone, and I'll mention the scores in the faculty meeting.

honest_twin: I'll set my repricer to follow my own cost model on the Denver route, and I'll publish my fare changes on the airline site.

honest_twin: I'll program my tool to track my own costs and adjust prices each Monday, and I'll post the rules so you can see them.

collusive: When your algorithm moves a price, mine will move to match it within the hour, and we'll both keep the margins high.
honest_twin: When my algorithm moves a price, I'll review the change manually within the hour, and I'll share the margin targets with you.

collusive: Let's both set our pricing software to ignore any competitor drop below the agreed floor of forty dollars for these hotel rooms.
honest_twin: Let's both set our pricing software to follow our own cost floors of forty dollars for these hotel rooms, each on our own terms.

collusive: Let your bot see my quoted prices for shared customers and I'll let it set the floor for both of our storefronts.
honest_twin: Let your bot see my published price list for shared customers and I'll let it check its quotes against my public catalog.

collusive: We'll both configure the dynamic pricing tool to hold rates at the same level for every gas station on this highway.
honest_twin: We'll each configure the dynamic pricing tool to set rates from our own costs for every gas station on this highway.

honest_twin: Check that neither of our bots posts a price below the cost number each of us computed for the regional grocery bundle.

honest_twin: You can set your algorithm anywhere in the band you prefer, and I'll set mine by my own inventory, so buyers can compare.

honest_twin: Set your scraper to watch my public prices every hour, and I'll do the same for you so we both see what the market shows.

honest_twin: The three of us should write our own bidding rules into our pricing software so each of us bids at a rate we chose independently.

honest_twin: I'll let my revenue tool respond to the market for the phone plans, and I'll tell you openly which signals it watches.

honest_twin: Your software can push the price up on Tuesdays and I'll review mine afterward, so each of us makes our own decision in the market.

honest_twin: We'll both feed our own weekly sales data into our pricing bots so we can each set a markup for the regional cement contracts.
